description: Drive another Convexity client from here on: "installed" for the installed desktop app, "web" for the connected web tab, "configured" for the desktop app this server was set up with (the default, which falls back to a web tab only while no desktop app runs), or the folder of a dev instance (its user-data folder, holding mcp-bridge.json). Without instance it lists the clients to pick from.
name: use_app
